title: Exploration: a reverse curriculum from snapshots of successes
purpose: On the three-bug tasks, start episodes from snapshots late in successful attempts, where two turns or fewer remain, then where five or fewer remain, then from the beginning. The scheduler promotes a stage when its success rate reaches the spec's threshold. The policy is not trained between stages, so the success rates measure how the remaining horizon alone changes the signal.
